citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Institutional Requirements for Sovereign Local Agent Runtimes (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=7314479

isBasedOn.name: Institutional Requirements for Sovereign Local Agent Runtimes

abstract: Contribution must be traceable well enough to support payment, credit, or recurring compensation without a central assignor. This requirement follows from the fourth defining property of the class. Once settlement is machine-to-machine, value allocation is a coordination problem rather than an accounting one, and a runtime that routes work without allocating value has externalized the hardest part of its own economics onto its participants.
